=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:687 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `assert ci.count("CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}") == 6` fails because .github/workflows/ci.yml contains that string only once (glm cites .github/workflows/ci.yml:3946).
  WHY: The tests-system-python (13), orchestrate-poll (3) and tests-sandbox-python (codex-isolated-codex) jobs fail on head c114e73, so the aggregate `lint` check stays red; both reviewers say the cause is on the base branch and outside this PR's diff, and they disagree on severity (sonnet MAJOR, glm NIT), so the highest is used.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:Scripts inventory | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Scripts inventory has no entry for scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh or scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh, so tests/inventory_parity.py reports both as missing.
  WHY: tests-release-and-log-analysis fails and the inherited `generate-check` failure follows, which keeps `lint` red; both reviewers call this base-branch drift that should not be fixed in this PR, and they disagree on severity (sonnet MAJOR, glm NIT), so the highest is used.
- tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py:~439-461 (test_repair_diagnostic_line_is_bounded_and_sanitised) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After `sort -u` (script line 375), `extra/odd name=x,y.txt` is the 25th path, and review_prepush_test_gate_diag_paths drops every path after the 20th, so the odd name never reaches `tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._/+-' '_'`.
  WHY: The field-count and character-class assertions would still pass if the sanitising line were deleted, so a regression in the `tr` line would pass CI.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:798-805 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The passing-change guard re-runs `review_prepush_test_gate_changed_checked` (line 800) instead of using the `rpg_post_repair_changed` / `rpg_post_repair_ok` values already set at lines 754-758 and logged in the diagnostic.
  WHY: If the second read fails or returns a different state, the guard can skip the revert (falling through to `rpg_repair=ran`) or misfire, and its decision no longer matches the logged `after=` value; reviewers disagree on severity (gemini MAJOR, minimax and glm NIT), so the highest is used.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:798-805 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: On every repair turn, `git diff --name-only HEAD` and `git ls-files --others` (plus the sed/sort pipe) run a redundant second time.
  WHY: With `rpg_max_turns` of 5, this adds up to 10 extra git calls per gate run, giving overhead on the pre-push hot path without any new information.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:730-763 (review_prepush_test_gate_repair_diag) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `PREPUSH_REPAIR_CHANGES` is emitted only after the `timeout` call to `bash "${editor}"` returns, so an editor that times out, crashes or is killed logs no diagnostic line.
  WHY: Without that line, the repair's behaviour cannot be diagnosed when the editor fails or hangs; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state that line 759 runs before the `rc -ne 0` early return, which refutes this.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:641-646 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The per-byte `tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._/+-' '_'` sanitisation is lossy: distinct paths such as `a b.txt`/`a?b.txt` or "lib/a b.py"/"lib/a=b.py" become the same string.
  WHY: `before_paths`/`after_paths` in `PREPUSH_REPAIR_CHANGES` cannot tell colliding files apart, so the diagnostic can hide which file the repair changed or erased (log fidelity only).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Every turn in which the editor ran also logs one PREPUSH_REPAIR_CHANGES line ... `truncated=1` when a list or path was cut. Path lists hold at most 20 paths of at most 200 characters, each reduced to `[A-Za-z0-9._/+-]` (other bytes become `_`)" (issue §Approach and §Constraints)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py:test_repair_diagnostic_line_is_bounded_and_sanitised
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The fixture creates 24 `extra/f##.txt` files plus `extra/odd name=x,y.txt` and `lib/a.py`; after `sort -u` the first 20 entries are `extra/f00.txt` … `extra/f19.txt`, so the `tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._/+-' '_'` reducer at line 641 of `scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh` never runs, and the `re.fullmatch` assertion would still pass if the `tr` line were deleted.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:687 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `assert ci.count("CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}") == 6`, but .github/workflows/ci.yml contains the string once; this PR touches only the agents.d/, changelog.d/, gate script and gate test files.
  WHY: tests-system-python (13), orchestrate-poll (3) and tests-sandbox-python (codex-isolated-codex) fail on head c114e73, so `lint` is red; the cause is on the base branch and the editor should not change these files in this PR.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:Scripts inventory | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh and scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh are missing from the inventory (tests/inventory_parity.py reports both), though README.md and agents.md reference them; this comes from the base branch.
  WHY: tests-release-and-log-analysis fails, which keeps `lint` red and explains the inherited `generate-check` failure; needs a separate base-branch fix.
- tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py:test_repair_diagnostic_line_is_bounded_and_sanitised | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After `sort -u` (script line 375), `extra/odd name=x,y.txt` is the 25th path and is skipped by the 20-path cap, so it never reaches `tr -c ... '_'`.
  WHY: The guarantee the test is named for is not tested, so a regression in the `tr` line would pass CI; the suggested fix is to rename the file to `extra/a odd=x,y.txt` and assert `extra/a_odd_x_y.txt` is in before_paths.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh review_prepush_test_gate_repair guard at lines 798-800 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The guard re-reads the changed-file list instead of using the post-repair state from lines 754-758, so its decision can differ from the logged `after=`.
  WHY: Suggested fix is `&& [ "${rpg_post_repair_ok}" = true ] && [ -z "${rpg_post_repair_changed}" ]` (1 line); sonnet rated the performance cost as not measurable and refuted the pass-1 timeout TASK_GAP (line 749 `|| rc=$?`, with lines 750-760 running before the rc branch).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:798-805 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard calls `review_prepush_test_gate_changed_checked` a second time and ignores the `rpg_post_repair_changed`/`rpg_post_repair_ok` values set at lines 754-758.
  WHY: A transient failure or a different state on the second read can make the guard behave incorrectly, fail to fire, or disagree with the logged `after=` value.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:730-763 (review_prepush_test_gate_repair_diag) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `PREPUSH_REPAIR_CHANGES` is emitted only after the `timeout` call to `bash "${editor}"` returns, so no line is logged if the editor times out, crashes or is killed.
  WHY: The log is incomplete for debugging future "Editor changes lost" occurrences.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:798-805 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: git diff/ls-files run redundantly on every repair turn.
  WHY: With `rpg_max_turns` of 5, this is up to 10 extra git calls per gate run.
- tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py:test_repair_diagnostic_line_is_bounded_and_sanitised | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Because of `sort -u` and the 20-file cap, "odd name=x,y.txt" is likely dropped before `tr -c`, so the test never exercises sanitisation.
  WHY: The test passes even if the sanitisation logic is removed or broken.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:798-800 (with 754-758) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard re-reads the post-repair changed set via `rpg_post_repair_changed="$(review_prepush_test_gate_changed_checked)"` although the diagnostic already populated it; the two reads can disagree, and a failure on only the second read silently stops the guard from firing.
  WHY: The logged `after=0` can differ from what the guard sees (a skipped revert, or a phantom erasure), so the event cannot be reconstructed deterministically from `PREPUSH_REPAIR_CHANGES` + `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE reason=...`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:800 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The guard re-runs `git diff --name-only HEAD`, `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` and the `sed | sort -u` pipe on every repair turn.
  WHY: Adds latency to the gate's hot path without new information.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Every turn in which the editor ran also logs one PREPUSH_REPAIR_CHANGES line ... Path lists hold at most 20 paths of at most 200 characters, each reduced to `[A-Za-z0-9._/+-]` (other bytes become `_`)" (issue §Approach and §Constraints).
  Expected change site: tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py:test_repair_diagnostic_line_is_bounded_and_sanitised
  Evidence of absence: The first 20 sorted entries are `extra/f00.txt` … `extra/f19.txt`, so the `tr` reducer at line 641 of `scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh` is never invoked, and the `re.fullmatch` assertion would pass without it.
- Cross-pollination note: minimax agrees the tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:684-689 and docs/INVENTORY.md:Scripts inventory failures are real, but considers them base-branch issues outside this PR's scope; it reports no task gaps against issue #9519's deliverables (confidence 5).
- HARDENING (2 related items): lines 798-800, replace the re-read with `&& [ "${rpg_post_repair_ok}" = true ] && [ -z "${rpg_post_repair_changed}" ]; then` (risk 2); test fixture, rename the odd file to `"extra/a odd=x,y.txt"` and assert its sanitised form is in `before_paths` (risk 1).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
